messages:
jason: Ping AcmeCorp POC stuck. SCIM connector returns 403 'token scope mismatch' and SAML assertion fails with 'Invalid certificate chain'. They moved from Hosted -> Dedicated (VPC) and pasted something into the SCIM token field. Need quick triage.
priya: can you paste the scim-proxy error and the SAML error snippet? also confirm which key string they pasted (starts with rudx-tenant- or not).
carlos: logs (redacted):
```
scim-proxy: 403 token scope mismatch - token audience: hosted-api, expected: tenant:acmecorp
saml-service: cert validation failed: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority (possibly intermediate missing)
```
jason: they pasted a token 'rudx-9a8b7c' (hosted-style) into Dedicated console. security team also uploaded an SP cert that our metadata doesn't accept; they said proxy replaced it during rotation.
priya: two independent blockers: wrong token type for SCIM (hosted vs tenant-scoped) and SAML cert chain issue. For SCIM the short-term fix is to issue a temp tenant-scoped token. For SAML, we need their IdP to send the full cert chain or use our metadata's certificate thumbprint.
onboarding-eng: issuing temp token now. Command I ran: `./bin/issue_token --tenant acmecorp --scope scim --ttl 3h` -> `rudx-tenant-temp-acmecorp-3h`. DM'd to customer.
carlos: to validate SAML cert chain quickly, ask them to run: `openssl s_client -connect idp.acme:443 -showcerts` and paste the full chain. We need to see if the intermediate CA is missing.
security-bot: note: when customers use VPC peering, SAML ACS callbacks come over the peering IPs; certs still need to validate against our trust store. We can't skip validation.
jason: they ran openssl and pasted intermediate cert missing. they can upload intermediate to Okta app or our team can provide guidance to attach chain.
priya: small mitigation steps we did: 1) swapped in tenant temp token for SCIM so provisioning can continue. 2) created a warning banner in console if a non-tenant key pattern is pasted into tenant fields (UX flag).
carlos: for long-term SAML fix: ask IdP to either (A) include full cert chain in the app configuration, or (B) export the signing cert from Okta and paste into our metadata UI which accepts full PEM chain. Also confirm ACS URL matches value in metadata (trailing slash matters).
jason: customer also reported occasional 502s when hitting scim over peering — I suspect path mismatch to /dedicated/<tenant>/Users. can you share curl test?
onboarding-eng: curl test for them:
```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer rudx-tenant-temp-acmecorp-3h" https://scim.redwood.company/dedicated/acmecorp/Users | jq .
```
priya: after we provided instructions they uploaded the intermediate cert and updated the SCIM key to the tenant token. re-triggered provisioning -> scim 201 Created. SAML assertion validated.
security-bot: follow-up: opened ticket INFRA-412 to add UI validation for key format and additional telemetry for cert chain failures (will surface to onboarding team).
jason: Customer confirmed POC users provisioned and SAML SSO works. Closing this thread. Thanks team! :white_check_mark:
